today_paragraph: GE HealthCare closed at $81.85, down 0.9% today on light volume. The daily trend is up: price is above its 20-day average, which is above the 50-day. The overall score is neutral (+11), so signals are mixed. Over the last month it has beaten the medical-device ETF (IHI) by 6 points. Options look cheap, assuming 29% yearly volatility versus 40% the stock has actually shown. The options market expects a move of about ±2% by Friday.
